items.description: Disposal of shed and fallen-tree debris
items.rationale: The shed timber and glass, green waste, and single root ball under 1 m³ all qualify under 5.2.1, so the combined line passes 7.1.10. Gross disposal estimate: €60 for timber + €32 for glass + €54 for green waste + €40 for the root ball = €186.

items.description: Disposal of soil, topsoil and paving grit
items.rationale: Section 5.2.1(d) excludes all three materials, and 5.2.2 does not cover standalone disposal without reinstatement-related ground works and making good. The €105 figure is a conditional price estimate only; no payment is due.
